Choosing pizza in Hongdae, Hapjeong and Sangsu

Choosing pizza? Start by deciding whether you want cheese-led flavours, varied toppings, or two flavours on a half-and-half. At Hongdae Hwaduk Pizza (홍대화덕피자), compare Quattro Formaggi, Quattro Stagioni and the available half-and-half combinations.

Four cheeses and the dough

Quattro Formaggi combines Gorgonzola, cream cheese, Reggiano and mozzarella. Gorgonzola adds a pronounced aroma, cream cheese a soft texture, Reggiano a savoury, nutty note, and melted mozzarella a stretchy texture. Try the cheese on its own, then compare a bite of the rim with the centre and its toppings. The oven guide explains our 72-hour dough and baking process.

Varied toppings on one pizza

Quattro Stagioni combines Quattro Formaggi, Croccante, Margherita and Diavola on one pizza. Choose it if you want to compare toppings, or consider Quattro Formaggi for cheese-led flavours. Use the actual menu photos to decide.

Choosing a half-and-half

If your preferences differ, a half-and-half lets you choose two flavours. This differs from choosing one Quattro Stagioni with its varied toppings. Decide which flavours you want, then check the combinations currently available before ordering.

Pairing pizza with pasta

To pair rich cheese with a different sauce, compare Gamberi e Rucola, an oil-based pasta with shrimp and arugula. For spicy cream and melted cheese, consider Gamberi Crema; for tomato sauce, compare Pomodoro and Gamberi Piccante in the pasta guide. These are dish-selection examples, not fixed sets or quantities for your party. Order according to tastes and appetites.

Plan your visit

The address is 5 Dongmak-ro 7-gil, Mapo-gu, Seoul, ground floor. Allow about five minutes on foot from Hapjeong Exit 6 or Sangsu Exit 1, or about fifteen minutes from Hongik University Station. Check the latest menu, prices and available combinations on Naver Place.
